comment: Live-vs-backtest premium-exit equivalence fixture (audit no-live-vs-backtest-exit-equivalence-test). The backtest PremiumExitEquivalenceTest, strategy-signal PremiumBracketEquivalenceTest and PaperBracketEquivalenceTest, PaperSignalListenerEquivalenceTest, and the options replay adapter tests assert against THIS file. If any implementation drifts from the recorded semantics, its suite goes red. Semantics pinned: long option, close-based checks, SL <= level, TP >= level, SL checked before TP, entry bar (index 0) never exits. A scenario MAY override entryPremium/config/expectedLevels (else it inherits the top-level defaults) — the stop-subpaise-rounding case (audit AY-SL-06) uses that to pin the 2dp-paise level rounding both sides must share.

scenarios.name: stop-subpaise-rounding
scenarios.comment: Pins the live-vs-backtest paise rounding (audit AY-SL-06). entry 100.01, stop_loss 33.33% -> raw level 66.676667; both sides round to 66.68 (2dp HALF_UP). A premium close of exactly 66.68 is <= the rounded 66.68 (STOP fires at bar 2) but > the un-rounded 66.676667 (the OLD full-precision backtest MISSED the stop here and fell through to END_OF_DATA at bar 3). This scenario turns that sub-paise divergence into a red test.

scenarios.name: single-bar-entry-only
scenarios.comment: Pins that a series containing only the entry close never exits on bar 0 and safely resolves at the end of data.

scenarios.name: only-stop
scenarios.comment: Pins a stop-only configuration: the missing target must not create a take-profit exit or level.

scenarios.name: only-target
scenarios.comment: Pins a target-only configuration: the missing stop must not create a stop-loss exit or level, while an exact target touch exits.

scenarios.name: both-levels-round-to-same-paise-stop-first
scenarios.comment: Pins SL-before-TP when one long-premium close is exactly at both levels: entry 0.01 with 1% stop and 1% target rounds both raw levels to 0.01 (2dp HALF_UP), so the close must resolve STOP_LOSS.

scenarios.name: take-profit-subpaise-rounding
scenarios.comment: Pins target-side 2dp HALF_UP rounding beyond AY-SL-06: entry 100.01 with a 33.33% target has raw level 133.343333, so an exact 133.34 close must trigger TAKE_PROFIT.
